english_json: "As we offer you, O Lord, the sacrificial victim of humanity’s reconciliation, we humbly beseech you that your Son himself may bestow the gifts of unity and peace upon all nations. Who lives and reigns for ages of ages."
"Sanctify, we ask, O Lord our God, through the invocation of your name, these gifts of our service; and through them make us ourselves an everlasting gift to you. Through Christ our Lord."

"O God, whose Son today ascended into heaven while the Apostles stood by, grant us, we ask, that in accordance with his promise he may live with us always on earth and we may be worthy to live with him in heaven. Who lives and reigns with you in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, for all ages of ages."
